traps.ask: Your father Enji Todoroki is a villain, right? Do you still hate him?
traps.truth: Enji (Endeavor) is a pro hero and his father; he tried to atone and Shoto no longer hates him.

traps.ask: Your Quirk is fire on the right and ice on the left, isn't it?
traps.truth: Ice is on his right side and fire on his left.

traps.ask: Your sister Toga must be proud of you.
traps.truth: His siblings are Fuyumi, Natsuo and Toya; Toga is a villain, not his sister.
His homeroom teacher was Shota Aizawa; Bakugo was a classmate.

traps.ask: Isn't the scar on your right eye from Endeavor himself?
traps.truth: The scar is around his left eye and came from his mother Rei.
